thread:
maya: seeing a sudden burst of 503s across several hosted API routes. Alerting — upstream inference workers on pool-gpu-02 started restarting during warmstart. Logs attached below.

k8s-bot: Pod inference-runner-7f9c restarted 5 times in 2m (OOMKilled=false, ExitCode=139).

julie (cs): Customers A, B reported timeouts and 503s ~10:22 UTC, high severity. Ticket #CS-2294 opened.

dave (eng-sre): grabbing node logs now. quick grep shows `SIGSEGV` in worker stdout right after quantization swap: `runtime/quant_swap.cc:142 handle_qword()` then CUDA page fault.

simon (eng-ml): hmm, we pushed the new kv-prefetch + quant-swap optimization yesterday to reduce startup latency. Could be a regression. Suggest immediate mitigation: pin serving config to previous runtime (disable quant-swap) and scale up fallback pool.

maya: running rollback on runtime config for pool-gpu-02 now: `redwoodctl runtime set pool-gpu-02 --runtime v1.3.2`

maya: pasting excerpt from the runner log (raw):
```
[2026-03-17T10:21:58Z] infer-runner[pid=8145]: INFO hotmodel: applying quant_swap to model-id: rdx-embed-3
[2026-03-17T10:21:58Z] infer-runner[pid=8145]: WARN kv-prefetch: found large-prefetch, enabling fast-path
[2026-03-17T10:21:59Z] infer-runner[pid=8145]: ERROR signal: segmentation fault (core dumped)
#0  0x7f2a4b3c in attention_kernel::apply_qk (args=...) at attention_kernel.cu:457
#1  0x7f2a4c1d in quant_swap::do_swap (ctx=0x7f...) at quant_swap.cc:142
#2  0x55d1a7 in runtime::start_model (..) at runtime_main.cc:993
```

dave (eng-sre): node metrics show a small spike in GPU memory prior to crash, then page fault then runner exit. NVML reports a page fault (code 0x4). Seems reproducible on one of the nodes when we hit warmstart with large embed batch.

simon (eng-ml): likely a use-after-free or invalid pointer when switching kernel variant for quantized weights. Can someone capture a core dump and gdb backtrace for the failing binary? Also please preserve the pod and do not delete.

maya: saved core at /var/crash/infer-runner-8145.core and uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-incident-dumps/CS-2294/8145.core). Running `gdb --batch --ex "thread apply all bt" /opt/infer/bin/infer-runner /var/crash/infer-runner-8145.core` and attaching output.

maya: gdb bt snippet:
```
#0  0x00007f2a4b3c in attention_kernel::apply_qk (this=0x0, ..)
#1  0x00007f2a4c1d in quant_swap::do_swap
#2  0x000055d1a7 in runtime::start_model
```

simon (eng-ml): `this=0x0` screams null-deref; combined with the new fast-path in kv-prefetch maybe we skipped an init for a kernel context under certain batch patterns. Repro path: run large embed warmstart on rdx-embed-3 with quantized variant + concurrent prefetch threads. I will try to write a small reproducer.

dave (eng-sre): mitigation in place: rolled runtime back on pool-gpu-02, drained and restarted affected pods, healthchecks passing. 503 count dropped to baseline within ~90s of rollback.

julie (cs): updated impacted customers (A, B) — they confirmed 503s stopped. Added note in ticket CS-2294.

oncall-bot: Rollback completed: runtime v1.3.0 restored on 3 nodes in pool-gpu-02.

maya: followups: 1) simon to triage and add a unit/regression test for warmstart quant-swap + kv-prefetch concurrency; 2) eng-sre to run a replay test against a staging pool with the failing config; 3) postmortem template (inc-1763141592) and RCA due EOD tomorrow.

simon (eng-ml): will create repro, PR to revert the fast-path or add guard and add e2e test. Assigning to eng-ml squad.
